header:
Awesome Freelancing and Agency Tools

> Open-source tools for freelancers and small agencies: projects, time tracking, invoicing, proposals, client portals and websites. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Put it in writing.** Scope, price and dates go in a contract.
- **Own your data.** Pick tools that export clients and invoices.
- **Check the license.**
- **Start small.** One tool for time and invoices is enough.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
